title: Wings
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Biplane, health
WWI flying game based on Cinemaware's Wings: campaign as a pilot in the Great War

rows: Flying ability, Shooting ability and Mech aptitude; points to allocate after missions

widgets.text:
Dogfights, strafing, bombing
Combat record per pilot; pilots can be lost, so keep your best ones alive

rows: dogfights, strafing ground targets, bombing runs
get on the enemy's tail and fire short bursts
release over the target from a steady height

widgets.text:
WWI campaign
Campaign mode follows the war; multiplayer modes: Battle Royale, Team Deathmatch, Balloon Battle (Allies vs Central Powers)

Bombs and guns
Machine guns and bombs depending on the mission

Medals
Medals and the pilot's combat record
Pilot skills improve with points after missions

Missions flown
Missions flown in the campaign
Campaign missions flown; multiplayer battles are separate
